nodes.label: WatchAtlas
nodes.description: A global streaming availability guide that shows where movies and TV shows can be streamed, rented, or bought across every country, grouped by continent

nodes.label: ShowCard Component
nodes.description: Poster card component reused across home rows, watchlist grid, and discover page for displaying movie/TV titles

nodes.label: Environment Variables & Secrets
nodes.description: Server-only: TMDB_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET, FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (Phase 2). Client: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_*, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Optional alert channels: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_TO

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.description: Deployed on Vercel. Every push to main ships to production; other branches get preview deployments. vercel.json schedules daily health-check cron at 09:00 UTC

nodes.label: Aurora Peak
nodes.description: Organization/author of WatchAtlas. GitHub org: aurora-peak. Project board at github.com/orgs/aurora-peak/projects/2
nodes.source_location: About section and Project Board section
